_comment: STATIC DATA LAYER for the duel system. Read it only through scripts/shared/football-data.mjs.
Nothing else in the build imports this file, so the day a live provider takes over there is
exactly one seam to move. The provider contract is documented in that adapter's header.
Every number here was checked by hand against two independent named sources before it was
written down, per the D-2026-08-04g sourcing ruling and the two-source rule in
CANONICAL-CONTEXT.md section 0. Sources are named per stat, not per file, and the page prints
them under the number they belong to.
APPEARANCES ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT. StatMuse and FootyStats both put Elliot Anderson on 38
Premier League appearances; Soccerbase says 30. StatMuse says Raul Jimenez played 36; SportBusy
says 27, which looks like starts rather than appearances but was not resolvable from either
page. Two sources that disagree kill the number, so the metric came off the card rather than
shipping a figure the desk cannot stand behind. Minutes played went the same way: 2,958 against
Scope is printed on the card as well as recorded here. This is Premier League league play only:
no cups, no Europe, no internationals. A card that implies a scope it cannot support is the
The API-Football key in .env cannot replace these figures. Its free plan stops at season 2024,
so 2025/26 is behind the paywall. See scripts/shared/providers/api-football.mjs.
